A forced common text downloader cannot serve the archive contract, and the repeated atomic-cache mechanics alone are a small boundary idiom.

items.quote: resale = auction * 0.95 if mode == "auction" and auction else None
items.what: model_craft_value restates Model.CraftValue (Model.lua:294) with the auction cut inlined as 0.95 instead of Model.lua's AUCTION_CUT = 0.05 (Model.lua:287), and with Python truthiness in place of Lua's.
items.why: A change to AUCTION_CUT would not reach the screenshots. Truthiness drift: Lua `auction and auction * (1 - AUCTION_CUT) or nil` treats auction == 0 as truthy, giving resale 0 and returning (0, "auction") when there is no vendor price; the Python treats 0 as falsy and returns (None, None). Also `mode == "none"` returns (None, None) vs Lua's single nil (harmless). Not reachable with the current scene (mode is hard-coded "vendor" at :204 and AUCTION has no zero price), so latent. The other named ports match exactly: round_money == Model.RoundMoney (same unit thresholds, floor(+0.5), max 1); model_recipe_cost == Model.RecipeCost (`is None` equals Lua `not` for numeric/nil values, empty list returns 0 in both); model_chance/model_color/model_cost_per_skill_up match with the 0-based index shift.
items.reason: model_craft_value keeps a zero auction price, as Lua's truthy 0 does
items.guard: lens-only: a behaviour bug, not a shape a rule can match; regression test tools/screenshots_test.py

items.quote:
"""Prices.lua ns.Price: no gathering profession covers these reagents, so vendor (when it's no dearer
    than the auction house) else auction."""
items.what: The port of ns.Price (Prices.lua:101) drops the Gathered() branch on the claim that no gathering profession covers the scene's reagents, but the scene itself gives the character Skinning (PROFESSIONS, screenshots.py:172 `("Skinning", 134366)`), while the scene comment at :163 says "A Leatherworker/Miner". Canonical home: Prices.lua ns.Price + Gathered.
items.why: Data/Sources.lua ns.GatheredBy maps all three scene reagents to skill line 393 (Skinning): [2318] Light Leather, [783] Light Hide, [2934] Ruined Leather Scraps. Core.lua DEFAULTS has gatherFree = true, and Prices.lua Gathered() returns {copper = 0, source = "gather"} for any item a known profession gathers. So the in-game addon for the character drawn (Leatherworking + Skinning tabs) would price Light Leather at 0 with source "gather"; the screenshot shows vendor/Auctionator costs, cost per skill-up and sort order the real addon would not produce. Either the PROFESSIONS tab list or the port is wrong; the port's docstring asserts an assumption the scene contradicts. Knock-on: source_text (:338-340) ports ns.PriceSourceText as a two-way `"vendor" if ... else "Auctionator, today"`, so a ported "gather" source would be mislabelled as Auctionator instead of failing like the Lua's error(). Other differences in price(): ns.db.vendor (recorded merchant prices) omitted (fine: empty in a fresh scene); priceCache omitted (no behaviour effect).
items.reason: owner-delegated 2026-09-27: price() ports Gathered; Light Leather reads as gathered
items.guard: lens-only: Hand port drift anti-pattern; ports need checking against the Lua

The two annotations of the same value disagree.
